row.problem_statement:
nested html links are broken with parse_block_html this is a variant of #81 example_in = '
Example.com
' mistune.markdown(example_in, escape=False, parse_block_html=True) will generate:
https://example.com">Example.com
if escape is toggled to True, it is also broken: '<div><a href="<a href="https://example.com">Example.com">https://example.com">Example.com</a></a></div>
